user.title: Photovoltaic plant
user.description: Link the plant entities: the form suggests the ones recognised by name. A device is created with the «Plant map» sensor, to use in the card, plus «Self-consumption», «Grid direction» and «Battery direction» when the entities to compute them are there.

potenze.name: Power
potenze.description: PV production is required. With the grid exchange the card shows the direction, and self-consumption is exact even with a battery.

data_description.consumo: Without the grid exchange, self-consumption is computed from this.

energie.name: Energy
energie.description: Optional: shown as boxes in the drawing.

accumulo.name: Storage
accumulo.description: Only with a battery: the storage block is drawn only if at least one of these is linked.

convenzioni.name: Sign conventions
convenzioni.description: How your meter counts. The suggestion comes from the current values: without a battery, the exchange has the same sign as production minus consumption.

error.entita_ripetuta: The same entity is selected for two different fields.

init.title: Entities, conventions and animation
init.description: Change the linked entities, the meter conventions or the animation full scale. Rename the entry to change its name.
